title: Calendar of a month
prompt: A month has 31 days and its first day is a Wednesday. Print its calendar with weeks starting on Monday. The first line is the header `Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su`. Then print one line per week. Every date is written right-aligned in a field of width 2, the fields of a week are separated by single spaces, and the days of the first week that come before the 1st are empty fields (two spaces). Do not print trailing spaces. So the 1 stands under the `We` of the header.
